Tangala Safari Camp | Thornybush Game Reserve part of the Greater Kruger National Park
Your Big 5 adventure Awaits
Welcome to Tangala Safari Camp
SITUATED IN THE WORLD FAMOUS BIG 5 THORNYBUSH GAME RESERVE
Tangala Safari Camp, located in the heart of the Thornybush Big 5 Game Reserve, offers an intimate and eco-friendly escape for nature enthusiasts. Established in 1940 and renovated in 2016, the camp combines heritage with modern sustainability, featuring solar-powered operations and accommodations that include three authentic bush chalets and six colonial-style tents. Each unit boasts an  en-suite bathroom, mosquito-netted twin beds, and private covered patios overlooking breathtaking views of the Drakensberg Mountain Range and an active waterhole. Guests can immerse themselves in authentic African cuisine, thrilling game drives, and the camp’s commitment to conservation, including its ongoing support for rhino protection. Tangala Safari Camp is a serene off-the-grid retreat, perfectly blending comfort with a profound respect for nature.

Safari
Experience the untamed beauty of Thornybush Game Reserve with two exhilarating game drives each day , expertly guided by our knowledgeable rangers and trackers. Set out in the early morning as the bush comes alive with the sounds of the dawn chorus, or venture out in the late afternoon, where the golden hues of sunset set the stage for unforgettable wildlife encounters.
From tracking the iconic Big Five to discovering the intricate details of the smaller wonders of the reserve, each game drive is a journey into the heart of Africa’s wilderness. Whether you’re a seasoned safari-goer or a first-time adventurer, our game drives promise breathtaking moments and memories to last a lifetime.

The best game sightings. - The game sightings and game drives were nothing short of amazing.
The area is rich in a diverse number of animals as well as many predators and elephants. ... read more Leopards are my favourite wild sighting and we saw two incredible sightings across 3 drives.
The food was lovely, never went hungry. The staff were professional and pleasure to be with. Nothing was ever too much. We enjoyed being at the pool in the day - looking out at the bush.

Great times in the bush - We had a wonderful 2 nights at Tangala. A small intimate camp with a lovely outlook on an active water hole. All of the staff were friendly and did there ... read more utmost to please. We had a wonderful safari experience with our guide Clement who ensured we had some unique sightings. The coffee and sundowners in the bush were a highlight. We also enjoyed getting to know the other guests. Meals are buffet style and all the guests share a long table. We also loved sitting in the boma before dinner. The food was simple and tasty. The reason for the four stars is that the accommodation is in need of upgrading. Rooms more rustic than one would expect at this price point and towels were old. The safari vehicle was also damaged in the back row causing an uncomfortable ride for those sitting there. One would also expect WiFi to be complementary. This did not stop us having a thoroughly enjoyable time. I hope the owners invest in improving this lovely intimate camp. Thank you to Johan and Madeline for being attentive hosts.

Amazing and fun experience with lots of animals! - After Cape Town, we flew up to the Kruger National Park area to stay at Tangala Camp. The employees and managers at Tangala, particularly, the safari guides Reason and Louis, ... read more were awesome! The managers, Johan and Madeleine, were also super nice and very accommodating. We saw a bunch of wild animals (painted wolves, hyena, leopard, lions, etc), and the driver/spotters knew everything about the animals and answered everyone’s questions. The camp is small with 20 people staying there, so we made friends with the other visitors in our car. The houses are really neat; they’re thatch roof style cabins that were fun to stay in. There are also various antelope that wander through the camp, which was fun to see. It was also my (now) fiancé and I’s engagement trip and first big trip out of the country, and Tangala was a great experience for new travelers!!

About Tangala Safari Camp
Tangala Safari Camp is more than just a destination it’s a legacy. Established in 1940, it stands proudly as one of the earliest safari camps in Thornybush, deeply rooted in the history and traditions of the region. Over the decades, Tangala has evolved to seamlessly blend its timeless charm with modern eco-conscious living.
In 2016, the camp underwent a thoughtful transformation with the addition of six colonial-style tents, offering a fresh take on classic safari elegance. Alongside these enhancements came a bold step towards sustainability—Tangala now operates entirely on renewable solar energy, a commitment to preserving the pristine ecology of the area for generations to come.
A pivotal moment in 2017 brought an unparalleled connection to the wild when Thornybush removed its fences, opening its borders to the iconic Kruger National Park. This change allowed wildlife to roam freely, creating unforgettable safari experiences in one of Africa’s most celebrated wilderness areas. At Tangala, history, sustainability, and extraordinary wildlife encounters come together to offer a safari adventure like no other.
giving back
At Tangala Safari Camp, we believe in making a difference both for the environment and the wildlife that calls it home. Our commitment to sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Completely off the grid, the camp is powered by renewable solar energy from our dedicated solar farm. Even our water is drawn from a borehole, sustainably pumped using solar power, ensuring we tread lightly on the land we cherish.
Beyond sustainability, Tangala plays an active role in rhino conservation. As these majestic creatures face growing threats, we proudly contribute monthly to initiatives that protect and preserve rhino populations in the area. By staying with us, you’re not just embarking on an unforgettable safari you’re becoming part of a legacy of care for the environment and its incredible wildlife.

Accommodation | Tangala Safari Camp
Accommodation
6 Colonial-Style Tents & 3 Authentic Bush Chalets
Welcome to Tangala Safari Camp, where nature s beauty meets understated luxury. Nestled in the heart of the bushveld, our intimate camp offers six colonial-style tents  and four authentic bush chalets, each designed to immerse you in the surrounding wilderness without compromising on comfort. Wake to the sounds of the African dawn, enjoy breathtaking views of unspoiled landscapes, and unwind in spaces that perfectly balance rustic charm and modern convenience. Whether you re seeking adventure or relaxation, Tangala promises an unforgettable safari experience.
Glamping
Our six colonial-style tents offer the perfect blend of comfort  providing a unique retreat in the heart of nature. Each tent is thoughtfully designed to be both spacious and inviting, featuring a fan to keep you cool during warm days and an en-suite bathroom complete with a shower and double basin for modern convenience. The private patio invites you to unwind, offering breathtaking views and a serene space to enjoy the tranquility of the natural world in complete privacy.
As night falls, let the soothing sounds of the surrounding wilderness lull you to sleep, creating an immersive connection to nature that’s both peaceful and rejuvenating. Whether you’re seeking adventure, relaxation, or a bit of both, our tent accommodation provides an unforgettable escape that seamlessly combines relaxation and the great outdoors.
Bush Chalets
Our three bush chalets offer an immersive and authentic African experience, where rustic charm meets thoughtful comfort. Designed to blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings, each chalet is equipped with a fan to ensure a cool and pleasant stay, as well as an en-suite bathroom featuring a shower and basin for your convenience.
A mosquito net adds an extra layer of comfort, allowing you to rest peacefully while staying close to nature. Step out onto your private patio to unwind and take in the serene beauty of the bush, where the sights and sounds of the wilderness create an unforgettable backdrop to your stay.
